name: Skins
author: Brett
description: Change skins in one place: a gallery of every skin with a live desktop and phone preview, one-tap Use skin, Back to skin, Restore to Default and Undo, for the whole hub, one app, one screen or one plugin (skin-switch@1). Every action is the same through the screen, the REST API (/api/plugins/skin-gallery/), MCP plugin commands, the CLI (skin-gallery.mjs) and voice. Nav → Plugins → Skins; Settings → Plugins → Skins; deep link #/skin-gallery?skin=<id>&scope=<scope>.
